chibi_sensei.rail.label: Steps
chibi_sensei.primary.goal_incomplete: Choose a recipe and a base model and describe the task first.
chibi_sensei.tip.goal_todo: Start with the recipe. It decides how your examples look.
chibi_sensei.tip.goal_in_progress: One clear paragraph is enough. Mention the language and who the model talks to.
chibi_sensei.tip.goal_done: Your goal is set. Next, collect examples.
chibi_sensei.tip.data_todo: Add examples by hand, import a file, or let Sensei generate some from your goal.
chibi_sensei.tip.data_in_progress: Run the dataset check whenever you like. It tells you what to fix.
chibi_sensei.tip.data_blocked: Something blocks training. Fix the red items in the list below.
chibi_sensei.tip.data_ready: Your dataset passes the checks. Training arrives in a later version; you can export the data now.
chibi_sensei.tip.training_todo: Here you see how long training would take on Kaggle. Starting a run arrives in a later version.
chibi_sensei.tip.test_todo: After training you can chat with your model here and compare it with the base model.
chibi_sensei.tip.use_todo: Later you can export your model or use it inside AuraGo.
chibi_sensei.data.hf_later: Importing from Hugging Face arrives in a later version.
